documents.text: : שלמה זלמן פרוש ; 1850–1898 ) was one of the founders of the Shaarei Chessed Fund and neighborhood in Jerusalem . [ 1 ] Biography [ edit ] He was born in Babruysk , Russian Empire ( now Belarus ) in 1850 to his father Rabbi Naftali Zvi Porush ( d. 1866 ) and mother Leah ( d. 1900 ) . He arrived in Eretz Yisroel as a boy in 1860 together with his parents and a brother Gershon and a sister . As a Jerusalem community leader of the Yishuv haYashan he created the Shaarei Chesed Free-Loan Fund
